Both address the same issue: anti-vaccine stance and need to vaccinate children. They seem to be responding to the same proposition: opposition to vaccinating children (i.e., they are against anti-vaccine campaign). Both share same stance (against anti-vaccine, favor vaccination). So likely STANCE_MAINTAINED.

We must ensure comparability: Are they responding to same proposition? Manifestation A mentions "pregação antivacina" by some commission, and says need to counter it. Manifestation B directly calls it "movimento antivacina". Both refer to anti-vaccine campaign. So yes same proposition: anti-vaccine campaign against child Covid vaccination. So STANCE_MAINTAINED.
